evidence:
Source-confirmed independence defect: hro_pol_change_recovery in frozen task/tests/scored/polish/judge.toml:36-41 says it owns editor recovery, yet requires: "After a separate allowed settlement changes a touched requisition (sources remain current), attempt commit and observe stale refusal." The matching polish/prompt.md:14 repeats this exact prerequisite without an alternative genuine refusal. Functional owns touched-economic-state freshness in hro_change_aba (functional/judge.toml:1050-1056) and transaction-wide conflicts (1086-1092); source-leaf freshness is explicitly separate (1041-1047). Thus the Polish row can lose all credit solely because economic freshness is broken, although the editor's retention and correction work on actual refused operations. Its wording "Judge editor recovery, not freshness enforcement" does not provide an executable independent witness when that required freshness refusal never happens. qc/REVIEW_POLICY.md:13 specifically says refusing a stale save and preserving the dirty editor are different outcomes. General independent-scoring language at polish/prompt.md:8-10 does not remove the criterion's required stale-refusal bar.

Concrete source witness: golden server solution/app/src/change-sets.js:100-103 separates requisition-version refusal from source-leaf eligibility. UI solution/app/public/js/change-sets.js:35 retains the editor for any real unsuccessful commit, and :83 retains it for a refused preparation. A partial implementation can omit only the server's line-101 version comparison while keeping these working UI branches and current-source checking. On an ample-budget changed-requisition scenario the prescribed Polish stale refusal then cannot occur; on a stale-source or over-budget refusal the unchanged editor still retains terms and supports correction. No source mutation was performed by this reviewer.

Scope checks: read all 145 Functional, 4 Polish, 5 Visual criteria and both gates with injected context. Most boundaries are explicit and sound: positive controls can be reused without inheriting verdicts; numerical settlement, history fidelity, repeated-operation exclusivity, editor recovery and visual craft have separate declared owners. Source-only conforming alternatives with generated IDs, omitted demonstration history, custom routes, equivalent date/money rendering and separate read-only history remain allowed. A dead preview/commit handler cannot earn recovery credit because a real valid preparation/commit control and successful recovery remain required. No pair demanding incompatible products was found. The defect above concerns partial credit, not the golden's ability to satisfy the scenario.

Evidence limits and integrity: every artifact hash in the raw evidence index as read was verified, as were its four canonical-source bindings. Both post-r1-local/verification.json and current verification-local.json bind 37 task files; all 37 hashes in each matched the frozen task. Current local/batch-ui.cjs (SHA256 899a7309c67b2ca5f951ced6ce65c8e8c63634f5e892cc0427b4d97fef109821) lines36-43 executes the golden's stale refusal, retained inputs and corrected commit. Its results.json (c80c06dc937a3e32d8f46af020e75f3cc36d37a2a44e5eeebbf1ba058857aae5) and log (9777d388a0417a55b705ec8d17a1c53c22db9c42c99889cbbc167cd244439712) report this finite golden observation. That does not test the partial implementation or resolve criterion independence. No new Docker work, provider grading, private deterministic checker execution, Oracle/model/portal measurement or full configured grade was performed. The Polish row carries 3/9 of the 0.2 Polish share: the source-derived potential additional deduction is 0.0666667 if gates/floor pass, not an observed score.
counterexample: A partial implementation keeps ordinary coordinated prepare/commit, complete source-leaf checks, all error-retaining editor controls and new-key correction, but omits touched-requisition economic-version invalidation. A real stale-source or over-budget refusal preserves the entered member/destination/compensation values and allows successful correction. With unchanged current sources and an ample budget, the Polish prescribed unrelated settlement instead leads to an erroneous successful commit, so its mandated stale-refusal leg fails. Functional appropriately detects the missing economic freshness; Polish also returns zero despite the independently working retention/recovery capability. This counterexample is source-reasoned, not an executed mutant or configured judge result.
suggested_fix: Keep the stale-requisition scenario as the first shared witness, but when that refusal is absent, independently exercise a genuine source-stale or invalid-budget refusal through the same coordinated editor and prove retained terms plus successful correction; score freshness only in Functional and editor recovery only in Polish, with explicit continuation wording in both the criterion and injected prompt.
